topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that apply a decoder trained only on overt (or attempted overt) speech to silent speech (mouthed, silently articulated, inner or imagined speech) without retraining and report the results. Any signal qualifies (neural, EMG, ultrasound, video, etc.). Boundary: those that also train on silent data (such as methods that transfer audible-side targets) are included if they separately report an audible-training-only baseline condition. Exclude those that use an audible model only for time alignment or initialization of silent data. Exclude transfer between whispered and normal voice in acoustic speech. Exclude transfer from listening (perception) to inner speech. Exclude those that only analyse similarity of neural activity without applying a decoder. Exclude matches in reviews or citations only. Count different versions of the same study as one item.

Include studies that decode continuous acoustic representations (spectrograms, MFCC or vocoder features, formants) from non-acoustic neural signals (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical electrodes, EEG, MEG, etc.) associated with speech production (overt, mouthed, attempted, imagined) and either output them as speech or evaluate them in a form convertible to speech. Boundary: exclude studies that reconstruct heard speech from activity during listening (perception). Exclude those that only decode text and then read it aloud with a standard speech synthesizer. Exclude BCIs that operate a synthesizer through limb motor imagery or the like, since this is not activity associated with speech production. Exclude matches in reviews, ethics papers or citations only. Count different versions of the same study as one item.

Studies that reconstruct a continuous acoustic speech representation (spectrogram, mel features, envelope or waveform) from neural recordings (EEG, MEG, ECoG, sEEG or intracortical) during perceived, produced, mimed or imagined speech and evaluate the reconstruction. Boundary: classification-only and text-only decoders are excluded; auditory attention decoding that only tracks an envelope to select a talker is counted by the ledger pattern but is not a reconstruction study; versions of one study count once. Design categories are full-text pattern matches and overlap: correlation, identification among candidates, mel-cepstral distortion, human listening test, STOI.

Neural (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical, EEG, MEG) studies of covert, imagined, mimed, inner or silent speech that decode or reconstruct speech and state how the covert ground truth is constructed. Design of interest: a continuous acoustic reconstruction scored against the same participant's overt recording of the same text, time-aligned (e.g. DTW). Boundary: class-label references, heard-stimulus references in perception studies and text-only references are other designs; acoustic whisper or NAM conversion is not neural; versions of one study count once.
topics.pattern: neural modality AND covert/imagined/mimed/silent AND acoustic reconstruction terms (ledger text)
